latestVersion.changelog:
- Major rewrite: Migrated from shell-based ASCII/SVG chart scripts to a Python matplotlib-powered generator.
- Supports 7 chart types: line, bar, pie, scatter, area, multi-line, and bar-compare.
- Simplified to a single `chart_gen.py` file, retired older shell scripts and SVG template files.
- New command-line interface with flexible arguments for data, chart type, labels, and output format.
- Enhanced support for multi-series charts and improved visual output for professional use.
